mapper.select: SELECT push_id AS id, push_title AS title, push_body AS body, push_type AS type, DATE_FORMAT(scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS scheduledAt, repeat_days AS repeatDays, repeat_time AS repeatTime, status, DATE_FORMAT(last_sent_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastSentAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt FROM push_notification WHERE push_type = 'SCHEDULE' AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC

SELECT push_id AS id, push_title AS title, push_body AS body, push_type AS type, DATE_FORMAT(scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS scheduledAt, repeat_days AS repeatDays, repeat_time AS repeatTime, status, DATE_FORMAT(last_sent_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastSentAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt FROM push_notification WHERE push_type = 'REPEAT' AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY push_id DESC

SELECT push_id AS id, push_title AS title, push_body AS body, push_type AS type, DATE_FORMAT(scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS scheduledAt, repeat_days AS repeatDays, repeat_time AS repeatTime, status, DATE_FORMAT(last_sent_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastSentAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt FROM push_notification WHERE push_type = 'SCHEDULE' AND status = 'PENDING' AND scheduled_at <= STR_TO_DATE(#{now}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC

SELECT push_id AS id, push_title AS title, push_body AS body, push_type AS type, DATE_FORMAT(scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS scheduledAt, repeat_days AS repeatDays, repeat_time AS repeatTime, status, DATE_FORMAT(last_sent_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastSentAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt FROM push_notification WHERE push_type = 'REPEAT' AND status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT push_id AS id, push_title AS title, push_body AS body, push_type AS type, DATE_FORMAT(scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS scheduledAt, repeat_days AS repeatDays, repeat_time AS repeatTime, status, DATE_FORMAT(last_sent_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastSentAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updatedAt FROM push_notification WHERE push_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_notification (push_title, push_body, push_type, scheduled_at, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{body}, 'SCHEDULE', STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduledAt}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), 'PENDING')
INSERT INTO push_notification (push_title, push_body, push_type, repeat_days, repeat_time, status) VALUES (#{title}, #{body}, 'REPEAT', #{repeatDays}, #{repeatTime}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.update: UPDATE push_notification SET push_title = #{title}, push_body = #{body}, scheduled_at = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduledAt}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE push_id = #{id}
UPDATE push_notification SET push_title = #{title}, push_body = #{body}, repeat_days = #{repeatDays}, repeat_time = #{repeatTime}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE push_id = #{id}
UPDATE push_notification SET status = 'SENT', last_sent_at = STR_TO_DATE(#{sentAt}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE push_id = #{id}
UPDATE push_notification SET last_sent_at = STR_TO_DATE(#{sentAt}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE push_id = #{id}
